reason: A DSH plugin that patches text-only model image handling and routes image, OCR, and PDF interpretation through configured visual APIs or local fallbacks.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 纯文本模型提供图片、OCR 和 PDF 识别能力，并通过宿主补丁与可配置的视觉服务完成处理。
summaries.en: Enables image, OCR, and PDF understanding for text-only DSH models through a host patch and configurable vision services.

capabilities: modifies DSH host behavior to allow image attachments for text-only models
routes images, screenshots, PDFs, and OCR tasks to configured visual, OCR, or document-processing services
calls external OpenAI-compatible APIs using user-provided credentials
writes vision service configuration to user-level environment variables
